observations: Photo 0: A cardboard shipping box printed with 'Nikon D750' and a separate 'Nikkor Lens 50' box, sitting on an orange sofa. A stock product image (gimbal with camera) is visible in the background, not the actual item.
Photo 1: Open outer box showing two white manual boxes labeled 'Nikon D750 User's Manual' and a French-language manual, plus more branded boxes in the background (Zhiyun gimbal box visible).
Photo 2: Interior of a box showing two items wrapped in bubble wrap, shapes not identifiable as a camera body or any specific part.
No actual camera body, lens, LCD screen, serial number plate, or power-on test is visible in any photo.
Watermark 'OLAJIDE AMOS BISHOP' overlaid on all images, consistent with reused/stock marketing photos rather than photos of the seller's own unit.

claims.claim: American used Nikon D750 Body, clean and pure as new, working perfectly
claims.evidence: Photos show only sealed/bubble-wrapped boxes, never the camera body itself, so 'clean, as new, working perfectly' cannot be observed; also no camera is visible at all to confirm it is even present.

claims.claim: The model is D850 (per seller's own added text)
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 boxes are printed 'D750', not D850, directly contradicting the seller's own follow-up statement.

risks.risk: Model identity is internally inconsistent (seller says D750 in title, D850 in body text; box says D750)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body's top plate and bottom serial plate showing the actual model name engraved on the camera, not the box
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified/lowest-tier body, cannot be priced as a confirmed D750 or D850

risks.risk: No photo shows the actual camera, only boxes and bubble wrap; item may be missing, empty box, or a different/lower item
risks.proof: Unboxing video or photo of the camera body unwrapped, powered on, showing lens mount, screen, and shutter count
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case as non-functional/unverified unit, same as 'not working'

risks.risk: Shutter count and sensor condition unknown (critical for DSLR pricing)
risks.proof: Photo/screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or a sample test shot

risks.risk: 'American used' import claim unverifiable, affects warranty/grey-market status
risks.proof: Photo of import/customs paperwork or purchase receipt with US retailer info
risks.if_unproven: treated as ungraded import, no premium applied

proof_requests: Photo of the camera body itself (not the box) showing the top LCD, lens mount, and model name plate
Photo/video of camera powered on with a test shot or menu screen showing shutter count
Clarification resolving the D750 vs D850 discrepancy, with the serial number visible
Photo of the bottom serial plate matching the model claimed
response.reason: Seller's own text contradicts itself on the model (D750 vs D850), and no photo shows the actual camera body, only boxes and bubble-wrapped contents with stock/marketing imagery and a watermark, a pattern consistent with a reused-image or non-existent-item scam.
